title: Terracept
safeHtml:
Terracept is the official name of the Origin World of Project Nazca. Before the establishment of the City World, Terracept was the main area of development for Nazca Railway between 2012 and March 10 2015, when development of Terracept terminated due to the release of Java Edition 1.8.

Contents

  • 1 Geography
  • 2 Nations
  • 3 Fun Facts
  • 4 Gallery
  • 5 Citations and References

Geography[]

Terracept consists of the four major areas as follows:

  • Terracept Continent: The center of Terracept. It is home to both Terminals of Terracept Division and is also home to the access point to Golden Division and Los Sengas.
  • Tremend Sea: A snowy continent similar to the modern-day Ingress in Los Sengas. Located to the southwest of Terracept Continent.
  • Vertin Peninsula: A peninsula located to the north of Terracept Continent.
  • Tropic Continent: A continent located to the north of Vertin Peninsula.

Nations[]

Terracept was also formerly home to four different nations between players, and they are named as follows:

  • United States of EtErNalGLX: Located at the southwest of Terracept Continent.
  • The Republic Kingdom of Alexandria: Located at the east of Terracept Continent near Grand Ruin, Imperial Ruin and Main Ruin
  • Gemu: The northernmost nation in Terracept Continent.
  • Eukaryote Kingdom: The nation that housed the most Terracept Division stations.

Fun Facts[]

  • Unlike Los Sengas, which is based on "Limited Creative Modes", Terracept is based on Survival Modes. Therefore, all Nazca Railway stations in Terracept Division contained Basic Station Facilities, such as Repair Stations, Brewing Stations, Enchantment Stations and Workshops. This characteristic would be passed on to Stations that are built in the first three Seasons and Pre-Season 4 of Los Sengas Division.

Fun Facts[]

  • This page is the 2000th page of this wiki.
  • The design of Rover Down Checkpoint in Los Sengas Division pays tribute to this station.
  • The name Terracept Division is only confirmed after this station completed construction.
  • This station is the first Terminal-class station to ever be built.
  • This is the first In station transit system in project nazca and the only one in Terracept division, but it is called a 'internal people mover'.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Chinese Name and English Name of this station has appeared in real life. While the Chinese Name of this station alludes to Langfang City in Hebei Province, the English Name of this station alludes to a residential buliding of the Same Name in Toronto.
  • This station is entirely located within the shopping mall of the Same Name. Similar arrangements can also be seen at Pinestand Station.
  • While the arrival of Pegasus Line to this station was never officially announced until the Introduction of S4E5, colored wool and signs for Pegasus Line were already seen at the control room of this station.

History[]

  • March 3 2023: This Station began construction.[2]
  • March 9 2023: This Station completed construction.[3]
  • March 10 2023: This Station began services alongside Snowty Line.
  • April 15 2025: This station began expansion of the Pegasus Line Part.
  • April 16 2025: This station completed expansion of the Pegasus Line Part.
  • June 14 2025: Pegasus Line extends from Clovefront Station to this station.

The Finnick Island is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago. This island, together with Finnick Isle nearby, are listed as protected islands. Development on these islands are forbidden.

Contents

  • 1 Transport
    • 1.1 Nazca Railway
    • 1.2 Roads
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 See Also
  • 4 Citations and References

Transport[]

Nazca Railway[]

  • Interisland Line Finnick Station

Roads[]

This island features two motor roads that are yet unnamed.

Fun Facts[]

  • This island is named after a former city administrator that is nicknamed Finnick.
  • This island is one of the three islands in West Metropolis Archipelago that are named after Finnick, the other two being Finnick Isle and Nick Fin Island. However, it should be noted that he does not own any of these three islands. Instead, he owns Brain Island.
  • A naturally spawned village is located at the northeast of this island. Among the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago, this island is the only island with a naturally spawned village.
  • Southern Loop also had plans to set up a Station on this island. However, due to changes in development plans, the plans never came to fruition.

See Also[]

  • Finnick Isle
  • Nick Fin Island

title: The Shuttle
safeHtml:
The Shuttle (Formally named Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division Shuttle), is a Point-to-Point (P2P) Personal Rapid Transit (PRT) system operated by NR Los Sengas Division.

Contents

  • 1 Concept
  • 2 Proper Nouns
    • 2.1 Node
    • 2.2 Link
    • 2.3 Routing Terminal
  • 3 List of Links
  • 4 Development Mode
  • 5 Operation Mode
  • 6 Gallery
  • 7 Citations and References

Concept[]

The Shuttle is designed to be a P2P service and does not have clearly defined lines. However, it runs in the style of a cobweb, with different junctions of the "cobweb" being the "stations of The Shuttle. Passengers can directly choose his destination from any given station on this system.

Proper Nouns[]

Node[]

"Node" is the term for "Stations" in The Shuttle. For instance, if Sava has a station for The Shuttle, it would be named "Sava Node" instead of "Sava Station.

Link[]

"Link" is the term for "Line that reaches the Destination". For instance, if a passenger travels on any line that can directly go to Sava Node, and head towards Sava Node, the line that he takes would be referred to as "Sava Link".

Routing Terminal[]

A facility for passengers to choose his/her destination node in any given node. It also has a function to "Reset Destination".

List of Links[]

  • Metropolis Link (Destination: Metropolis Terminal)
  • Sava Link (Destination: Sava Node)
  • Katadelphia City Center Link (Destination: Katadelphia City Center Node)
  • Media City Link (Destination: Media City Node)
  • Prosand Link (Destination: Prosand Node)
  • Midway Island Link (Destination: Midway Island Node)
  • Old Brightland Link (Destination: Old Brightland Node)
  • Wui King Link (Destination: Wui King Node)
  • Central Numpool Link (Destination: Central Numpool Node)

Development Mode[]

The Shuttle runs as an independent rail system. It does not appear in Main Chapters of Nazca Railway, but would randomly appear in different places.

Operation Mode[]

The Shuttle operates in accordance to the Terracept Division with regards that it does not have Platform Screen Doors, does not have Departure Routines and has its own style of announcements. Moreover, in accordance to the concept of The Shuttle, one platform can have more than one destination. Therefore, passengers shall choose their own destination first before proceeding to the respective platform. It should be noted that The Shuttle runs in the same speed as Veloducts.

The Three Pass Station is a station on West Ring Line, Sava Line and Phoenix Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Sava. Passengers may also use this station to change to NR Buses Route R20.

Station Souvenir Hints (Now Demolished)[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.

  • Stars: 1
  • Find three different sets of pressure plates and step on all of them in the right order.
  • Finding them in the right order is important as well.
  • Once you found all the pressure plates, walk up the stairs at the south end of the West Ring Line Platforms.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a hopper.

Station Gauntlet Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 3
  • There are three different signs hidden across the stations, with a question on each of them. Answer all of them accordingly at the pressure plate area.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a Cauldron.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the first Station to undergo expansion in 2020.
  • The Platform 1 This Station features the first Through Service trains in Nazca Railway with Luxter Line Upwell Sand Station.
  • The Sava Line Part of this station alludes to Ma On Shan Station of the MTR in Hong Kong, while also alluding to the West Ring Line Section of this station.[5]
  • At the time of the construction of Sava Line, the Sava Line Concourse did not have any exits. This in turn also alludes to Ma On Shan Station, which did not have any exits on the ground level.
  • Sava Line Sayler Depot branches off from the main tracks at the west of this station.
  • The Sava Line Platforms were originally 152m long, but have since been extended to 204m long during the Phoenix Line Extension.
  • The Heightened Basic Platform Gates At the Sava Line Platforms are not added until the Phoenix Line Extension.
  • The largest floor heights at this station is 32m from Y=55 at the Phoenix Line Concourse to Y=87 at the Sava Line Concourse

History[]

  • March 21 2015: This station began services alongside West Ring Line.
  • February 3 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[6]
  • July 16 2016: This station completed the first expansion. At the same day, Sava Line extends from Venus Street Station to this station.
  • December 17 2016: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[7]
  • February 25 2017: The Departure Routine has upgraded from Generation II to Generation III.[8]
  • April 4 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[9]
  • October 3 2017: Sava Line Platform Numbers have been swapped.[10]
  • April 23 2020: This station completed the second expansion.[11]
  • March 2 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[12]
  • March 12 2022: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[13]
  • May 27 2022: This station completed exit naming.[14]
  • May 8 2023: This station began the third expansion.
  • May 9 2023: Sava Line Platforms have extended from 152m to 204m.
  • May 13 2023: This station completed the third expansion.
  • May 14 2023: Phoenix Line extends from Maysang West Station to this station.
  • June 28 2023: This station completed exit naming.

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2
  • Find secret passages and buttons. In total there are three buttons.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a thick potion.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the last station to undergo expansion in 2016.
  • Much like most stations in Terracept Division, the station name in Standard Galactic Alphabet is shown at the top of the Luxter Line Platforms.

History[]

  • December 27 2015: This station began services alongside Luxter Line.
  • September 25 2016: The East Ring Line, Charlie Line part of this station completed expansion. At the same day, East Ring Line and Charlie Line extends from Pale Rivering Station and Polibiomes Station to this station respectively.
  • September 26 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[8]
  • December 14 2016: Platform 1 of this station completed recovery.[9]
  • July 2 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[10]
  • January 6 2021: The Luxter Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[11]
  • September 7 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[12]

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is A Wispy Channel.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Of Soil and Splendor, Of Jest and Joy".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)

Threads Beneath the Flow 02:45

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 3.5-4
  • Find secret passages and buttons. In total there are three buttons. However, each button must be pressed within a certain time limit, and the passageway to the next button won't appear until a certain time period after the previous one is pressed.
  • Station Control Room -> Arcgo Line Platforms -> West Concourse
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a mundane potion.

Fun Facts[]

  • Unlike in Thick River Station, where the East Ring Line and Charlie Line Platforms were built later, the Arcgo Line platforms of this station were already built in Season 1, Episode 19.

History[]

  • December 29 2015: This station began services alongside Luxter Line.
  • April 24 2016: Arcgo Line extends from Internal River Station to this station.
  • September 26 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[8]
  • July 24 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[9]
  • January 6 2021: The Luxter Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[10]
  • February 18 2024: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • September 24 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[11]
  • April 5 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[12]

Thinbeach Tunnel is an underwater tunnel in NR Los Sengas Division.

Description[]

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station, as well as Three Line Island itself, is named after the fact that three rivers exist on the island to cause the island to be split in three.[2] Despite development on the island, the three rivers still exist to this day. To allude to this fact, this station has three exits with three passageways between the long passageway and the platform, uses three colored wools, and the station sign also has three white lines on it.
  • This Station is the first Island Station on Egress Line.

History[]

  • March 12 2020: This station began services.
  • May 22 2021: Exits B2, C1 and C2 are added to this station.[3]

title: Threeler
safeHtml:
Threeler was one of the Districts of Los Sengas. It consisted of Vayler, Mayler and Jayler. At the time of its existence, its District Number was 6, and was represented by Dark Blue. This district mainly consisted of deserts, and at the time, it had the second lowest number of sub-districts (behind Peckern North). As the manager of this district left the server due to historical reasons, it merged with Sava on March 4 2018 and became one of Sava's Sub-Districts.

plainTextExcerpt: Threeler was one of the Districts of Los Sengas . It consisted of Vayler, Mayler and Jayler. At the time of its existence, its District Number was 6, and was represented by Dark Blue. This district mainly consisted of deserts, and at the time, it had the second lowest number of sub-districts (behind Peckern North ). As the manager of this district left the server due to historical reasons, it merged with Sava on March 4 2018 and became one of Sava 's Sub-Districts. title: Through Service
safeHtml:
Through Services (Named In-Train Interchange in Nazca Railway), is a concept of passenger transport that involves a vehicle travelling between lines, networks or operators on a regularly specified schedule, on which the passenger can remain on board without alighting. This mode of operation is very frequently seen in railways, so that passengers have a more convenient route to reach their destination.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Platforms in this Stop are 100m long, which are slightly longer than the standard Local Rapid Transit Platforms.
  • If Pre-Season 4 Stations are considered, this station is the last stop to be built by Nazca Railway in Season 3.

History[]

  • June 11 2024: This Stop began construction.
  • June 27 2024: This Stop completed construction.
  • June 28 2024: This Stop began services. Tin Kam Line completed development.

Description[]

Tin Kam Line is Line 1 of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division Peckern North LRT. It runs along Peckern North Dansein, Tin Shek and North Tin Kam.

This route is represented by Green on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number PN-1.

Line Charcteristics[]

  • One of the Local Rapid Transit Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • All the stops along this line uses Medjay Platform Gates.

Fun Facts[]

  • While Local Rapid Transit lines usually aren't developed in Main Chapters of Nazca Railway development, this line was an exception as it was included as part of Pre-Season 4 Phase 3 development.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Glinstrouß Line Platforms are located directly above the Tin Kam Road Transportation Interchange Hub, whereas the Everchord Line Platforms of this station are located to the Southeast.[5]
  • The Glinstrouß Line Platforms of this station are 256m long to cater for the distance between the Glinstrouß Line Lower Concourse and the Transfer Concourse.[6]
  • At the time of the Station’s completion, this station had 28 exits and has therefore overtaken Bonyal Bay Station as the station with the most exits besides of Metropolis Terminal. Currently, this station has 32 exits.
  • This Station was named Tin Kam Bay Station during the planning stages of Glinstrouß Line.
  • The Western Side of this station is directly connected to both platforms of Tin Kam Stop.
  • The Eastern Side of this station shares structure with The TKOcean^2 Shopping Mall.

History[]

  • July 27 2021: This Station completed construction.[7]
  • July 28 2021: This station began services. Everchord Line is established.
  • May 26 2024: Exits Y, Z are added to this station, with Exit Z connecting to Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Stop.

safeHtml:
Tin Kum-Shek Pai Tau New Town (Abbreviated as Tin Shek New Town) is a new town of Peckern North. Areas include Tin Kam and Shek Pai Tau.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Current Residential Development
  • 3 Transport
    • 3.1 Nazca Railway
    • 3.2 Routes
  • 4 Citations and References

History[]

After the beginning of development of Dansein, a new development to the southwest of Dansein Market also began in the form of a series of public housing. However, due to geological constraints, this development extended to the west in what will become Tin Kam Estate. The Tin Kam Pier Bus Terminus is also constructed at the coast.

However, due to historical reasons, while Tin Kam and Tin Kum share the same Chinese Name (天琴), there have been inconsistencies regarding how the Chinese name was translated. Despite the construction of Tin Kam Station in July 2021, the naming differences between the buildings is still a problem regarding city development in Tin Kam.

title: Tin Wing
safeHtml:
Tin Wing is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the Central North Area of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-04.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Housing
    • 2.1 Public Housing
    • 2.2 Home Ownership Scheme
    • 2.3 Private Sector Participation Scheme
    • 2.4 Private Housing
  • 3 Transport
    • 3.1 Major Roads
  • 4 Citations and References

History[]

There has been speculation regarding the origins of the name Tin Wing. One of them has to do with paying homage to Jaime Cheung, a member of the Hong Kong-based Beanies, and the other symbolizes the fact that this district has gathered talents from all across Los Sengas and that citizens in this Sub-District have a Higher Average IQ.

Currently, all land transport to and from West Asylum must pass through Tin Wing, and could only leave Asylum through Beanies Road. This causes a Bottleneck Effect regarding vehicles until Asylum and Snowty can be connecte by a Major Road. Therefore, Tin Wing can be seen as a junction for road Transport as both Pak Hoi Road and Beanies Road need to carry a significant amount of Traffic Flow.

In response to the name of this District, this District is home to the only "School Estate" in Asylum, which houses a total of nine Secondary and Primary Schools.

During Initial Construction, the Developer has taken notice of a lack of Home Ownership Scheme housing supply within Asylum, and has therefore made the decision to increase supply of such housing within this Sub-District in order to provide increased housing opportunities for the lower Middle Class. As a result, this Sub-District has the largest proportion of Home Ownership Scheme housing in Asylum.
